title: AMENDMENT OF ARTICLE 2, ARTICLE 3, ARTICLE 6, ARTICLE 7, ARTICLE 10, ARTICLE 11, ARTICLE 13, ARTICLE 16, ARTICLE 19, ARTICLE 24, AND ARTICLE 26 OF THE SUB-DECREE 160 ANK/BK DATED 29 JULY 2016 ON THE ORGANIZATION AND FUNCTIONING OF THE CAMBODIA HALAL STEERING COMMITTEE
text:
Unofficial Translation
KINGDOM OF CAMBODIA
NATION RELIGION KING
Royal Government of Cambodia
No.14 ANKBK
/
SUB-DECREE
ON
AMENDMENT OF ARTICLE 2, ARTICLE 3, ARTICLE 6, ARTICLE 7, ARTICLE 10,
ARTICLE 11, ARTICLE 13, ARTICLE 16, ARTICLE 19, ARTICLE 24, AND ARTICLE 26 OF
THE SUB-DECREE 160 ANK/BK DATED 29 JULY 2016 ON THE ORGANIZATION AND
FUNCTIONING OF THE CAMBODIA HALAL STEERING COMMITTEE
Royal Government
- Having seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0918/925 dated 6 September 2018 on the Appointment
of the Royal Government of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0320/421 dated 30 March 2020 on the Appointment
and Reshuffling of Composition of the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0618/012 dated 28 June 2018 promulgating the Law
on the Organization and the Functioning of the Council of Ministers
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0196/16 dated 24 January 1996 promulgating the Law
on the Establishment of the Ministry of Commerce
- Having seen the Sub-Decree No. 38 ANK.BK dated 16 March 2020 on the Organization and
Functioning of the Ministry of Commerce
- Having seen the Sub-Decree No. 160 ANK/BK dated 29 July 2016 on the Organization and
Functioning of the Cambodia Halal Steering Committee
- According to the request of the Minister of Commerce
DECIDES
CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article One._
Article 2, Article 3, Article 6, Article 7, Article 10, Article 11, Article 13, Article 16, Article 19,
Article 24, and Article 26 of the Sub-Decree 160 ANK/BK dated 29 July 2016 on the Organization and
Functioning of the Cambodia Halal Steering Committee are amended as follows:

Article 2. _New
The following key terms used under this sub-degree shall have the meaning as defined hereunder:
- “ ” or “HALAL” “للاح” (an Arabic Word) refers to any object or service which is
ហាឡាល
permissible to use or engage in accordance with Islamic law. These terms are commonly used in
relation to food products, meat products, cosmetics, personal care products, pharmaceuticals, food
supplements, food ingredients, and other consumables.
- Product refers to the general category of goods such as groceries, foods, or services that serve
customer's needs or wants.
- Halal Products refers to raw materials and products which occur naturally or are produced
according to Halal Product Technical Standard that do not contradict to the provisions of Islamic
Law.
- Cambodian Halal Products refers to services, production, and packaging of the Halal Products in
Cambodia.
- Service refers to the acceptance of works, authorization, permission to use or for any profit or deed
by asking for dividends or other benefits, but do not include recruitment under labor law.
- Production refers to processing, blending, mixing, assembling, creating, or transforming images
including formatting, resizing, distribution, packaging, or storage.
- Packaging refers to packaging the finished halal products according to the Cambodia Halal Product
Technical Standard.
- President of the Highest Council for Islamic Religious Affairs of Cambodia refers to the
President of the Highest Council for Islamic Religious Affairs in Cambodia that are appointed by
His Majesty the King of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
CHAPTER II
COMPOSITION OF THE CHSC
Article 3. _New
The CHSC composes of the following members:
- Minister of Commerce Chairman
- Senior of Muslim Leader 1 person Vice Chairman
- Secretary of State of the Ministry of Commerce 1 person Vice Chairman
- Representative of the Office of the Council of Ministers 1 person Member
- The President of the Cambodian Highest Council for Islamic
Religious Affairs 1 person Member

- Representative of the Ministry of Interior 1 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Economic and Finance 1 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and
International Cooperation 1 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology
and Innovation 1 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Justice 1 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Labor and Vocational Training 1 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry
and Fisheries 1 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport 1 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Cult and Religion 1 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Health 1 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Tourism 1 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Information 1 person Member
- Representative of the Ministry of Women’s Affairs 1 person Member
- Director General of the Consumer Protection, Competition
and Fraud Repression Directorate-General Member
The actual composition of the CHSC shall be appointed by the decision of the Royal Government
of Cambodia.
Article 6. _New
The CHSC has the Consumer Protection, Competition and Fraud Repression Directorate-General
of the Ministry of Commerce as the Implementing Body and has the Halal Department of the Consumer
Protection, Competition and Fraud Repression Directorate-General as secretariat.
The Organization and Functioning of the CHSC Secretariat shall be determined by Prakas of the
Minister of Commerce.
Article 7. _New
To establish Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group under the CHSC which is responsible for
providing advice related to Halal Products to the CHSC in order to review technical standards, monitor the
provision of services, production or packaging of Cambodian Halal Products, and issue the Certificate of
Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard, which will then be approved by the Minister of Commerce,
who is acting as Chairman of the CHSC.

Article 10. _New
A natural person or legal entity, who intends to provide services, production, and packaging of
products marked or labeled “ ” or “HALAL” “للاح” in the Kingdom of Cambodia, at first, shall
ហាឡាល
prepare and submit the Application Form for the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard
at the Halal Department of the Consumer Protection, Competition and Fraud Repression Directorate -
General of the Ministry of Commerce.
Without the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard, provision of services,
production, or packaging of products marked or labeled “ ” or “HALAL” “للاح” or distribution in
ហាឡាល
the Kingdom of Cambodia shall be prohibited, although with or without the intention of doing business.
Article 11. _New
A natural person or legal entity who provided services, production, and packaging of the Halal
Products which holding certified halal certificate from other Halal Certification Body of any foreign country
other than the Kingdom of Cambodia, at first, shall prepare and submit the Application Form for the
Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard at the Halal Department of the Consumer
Protection, Competition and Fraud Repression Directorate -General of the Ministry of Commerce.
Without the Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard, any provision of services,
production or packaging of products which marked or labeled “ ” or “HALAL” “للاح” in the
ហាឡាល
kingdom of Cambodia, shall be prohibited, although having Halal Certificate issued by other Halal
Certification Body of foreign countries other than the Kingdom of Cambodia.
Article 13. _New
Once the provision of service, production, packaging of product satisfied the quality assessment
requirements of halal product technical standard, the CHSC and the Cambodia Halal Technical Working
Group will issue theCertificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard to applicant which shall not
exceed 3 months.
The Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical Standard shall be issued by the President of
the Cambodia Halal Technical Working Group with approval from the Minister of Commerce who is acting
as chairman of the CHSC.
Article 16. _New

The Consumer Protection, Competition and Fraud Repression Directorate-General shall assign
competent official to inspect the use of Halal Logo and Certificate of Cambodia Halal Product Technical
Standard on products, storage warehouses, or markets or sites of service provision and imported Halal
products.
Article 19.-New
The payment of provisional fine shall lead to termination of criminal actions.
In case the offender refuses to pay the provisional fine, the competent officials of the Consumer
Protection, Competition, and Fraud Repression Directorate-General may bring the case of offense to the
court following the legal procedure.
The competent officials of the Consumer Protection, Competition, and Fraud Repression
Directorate-General shall request to the competent prosecutor to seize the evidence of the offense.
Relevant stakeholders who object to any decisions may appeal to the competent court.
Articles 24.-New
Legal entity shall be declared criminally liable under conditions as stated in Article 42
(Criminal Liability of Legal Entities) of the criminal law for offenses as stated in Article 21 to Article 23
of Sub-Decree No.160ANK/BK dated July 29, 2016 on the Organization and Functioning of the
Cambodia Halal Steering Committee.
Legal entity shall be punished by the provisional fine not exceeding 10,000,000 (ten million)
Riels.
Punishment shall be doubled if it is violated again within a 2-years period.
Article 26. _New
Legal entity shall be declared criminally liable under conditions as stated in Article 42 (Criminal
Liability of Legal Entities) of the criminal law for offenses as stated in Article 25 of Sub-Decree
No.160ANK/BK dated July 29, 2016 on the Organization and Functioning of the Cambodia Halal Steering
Committee.
Legal entity shall be punished by the provisional fine not exceeding 5,000,000 (five million) Riels.
Punishment shall be doubled if it is violated again within a 2-years period.
Article Two. _
Any provision contrary to this Sub-Decree shall be abrogated.

Article Three. _
The Minister in-charge of Council of Ministers, the Minister of Economic and Finance, the Minister
of Commerce, all Ministers from relevant ministries and the President of the Highest Council for Islamic
Religious Affairs of Cambodia are responsible for enforcing this Sub-Decree from the date of its signing.
PRIME MINISTER Signed and Sealed
